description: This is a PHP source file defining the Modification class within the Opencart Admin Controller Marketplace namespace. The class manages marketplace modifications, including listing, refreshing, and handling modification files and XML logs.

classes.name: Modification
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing marketplace modifications, including listing, deleting, enabling/disabling modifications, refreshing modification files, and internal handling of modification XML logs.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for displaying the modifications page, loading language files, setting page title, preparing data including URLs, breadcrumbs, logs, modifications list, permissions, and rendering the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles displaying a list of modifications, including sorting, ordering, pagination, and rendering the modifications list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a JSON string of the current modifications list based on sorting, ordering, and pagination parameters.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes modification files, scans and loads modification XML logs, and resets modifications if the user has permission. Also sets the maintenance mode accordingly.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Outputs the content of the modification process logs.

methods.name: getLog
methods.description: Reads and returns the contents of the ocmod.log log file, HTML-encoded.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all modifications, deletes modification files, resets configurations, and logs the actions.
